resource_note: One separate six-hour reproduction allowance was recorded before fresh target evaluation, preserving all prior time and the original 180-minute protocol. Their fresh outputs exist; these five old-file comparisons are not claimed as verified. This is a reference-archive access limitation, not a missing source dependency in the public workflow.
